Vision

children.text: We are Halal producer of Ready To Eat and Ready To Cook product which will help you at your kitchen. Contact us for any enquiry.
Rooted in Sarawak
We support the local economy by producing downstream products based on local resources such as Sarawak's black pepper and palm sugar.

$media.alt: Sago palm fruit among green stems

children.text: We are committed to conducting business in a way that benefits society and the environment.
ZIAS Company is based at Metrocity Commercial Precinct in Kuching, Sarawak.
Lot 6, (Ground Floor), Lot 14182, Section 65, KTLD 7E, Metrocity Commercial Precinct, Jalan Matang, 93050 Kuching Sarawak.

Returns
Contact the store before sending an item back. Include your order ID and the email used at checkout so support can confirm eligibility and next steps.
Commerce confirms availability and recalculates the total before payment. Enter your delivery details, choose an available payment method, and continue securely.
Payment details are handled by the selected payment provider. This storefront does not store card details.

We use the information you provide to process orders, communicate about delivery, prevent fraud, and provide support. Payment details are entered on the selected provider's hosted checkout and are not stored by this storefront.
By placing an order, you confirm that your delivery details are accurate and that you are authorized to use the selected payment method. Prices and availability are confirmed by Commerce at checkout.
